name: Brageskålen
source:
Brageskålen is a Norwegian visual novel where the player's choices drive the story. You play as a young skald on Veøya in the year 986. An important part of the game is performing kvad, a nordic form of poetry which will influence how people view you, from romantic poems to heroic tales. The game's backdrop and story are based on historical sources.

A big battle is brewing, and Veøya's warriors are sending ships to fight the Jomsvikings. A mystical curse flips everything on its head as the able-bodied men of Veøya all get sick. You and your friends are the only ones who can figure out who is behind the curse. Can you solve the mystery?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2343910/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《Brageskålen》是一部挪威视觉小说，玩家的选择将推动故事发展。你将扮演公元986年Veøya岛上的年轻吟游诗人。吟诵kvad（一种北欧诗歌）是游戏的重要环节，从爱情诗到英雄史诗，你的表演会影响他人对你的看法。

游戏背景和剧情均取材于历史资料。

一场大战一触即发，Veøya的战士们正派出船只与Jomsvikings（约姆斯维京人）交战。一场神秘诅咒彻底打乱了局面，岛上所有身强力壮的男人都病倒了。你和朋友们成了唯一能查明诅咒幕后黑手的人。你能揭开谜团吗？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2343910/]Steam[/url]]
